custom_metrics.notes:
git commit -m "Schema Design Changelog

Self-Management App — Database Architecture

v1.3.0 — Logging Strategy Finalized
- todoTasks updated in place (no separate log collection)
  - status transitions: todo → in_progress → completed
  - procrastination fields updated directly on document
- habitDefinitions used only for config changes, not logging
- habitLogs creates new document per log entry (summed per period)
- Streak and procrastination fields updated after each log

v1.2.0 — Habit Procrastination System Clarified
- Removed flat totalMissedPeriods / lastMissedAt
- Added missedDates array for full miss history
- Added longestMissStreak and currentMissStreak derived from missedDates
- Added procrastination.enabled (true only when timeBlock.enabled = true)
- habitLogs.timeBlock.minutesLate set to null when no time block
- Anytime habits track misses only
- Time-blocked habits track full procrastination clock + misses

v1.1.0 — Core Schema Decisions Locked
Procrastination (Todo):
- Triggered automatically (past estimatedStartTime) or manually
- Clock starts when estimatedStartTime is reached and task not started
- checkpoints[] records procrastination over time
- totalMinutes accumulates until completion and is then frozen

Habit Logs:
- Multiple entries allowed per period
- Entries summed into periodTotalValue
- completionPercent = (periodTotalValue / targetValue) * 100

Streak Logic:
- Default allowedMissesBeforeBreak = 1
- Configurable per habit

Categories:
- Predefined + custom user categories
- Stored in categories collection with slugs
- Referenced by slug across collections

Exercise Sessions:
- Only walk and run supported
- Metrics: distanceKm, steps, avgPaceMinPerKm, caloriesBurned, mood, energy

v1.0.0 — Initial Schema Architecture
Collections:
- categories: classification lookup
- todoTasks: one-time tasks with procrastination tracking
- habitDefinitions: recurring habit definitions
- habitLogs: per-entry logs
- exerciseSessions: walk/run tracking
- dailySummaries: aggregated daily snapshot

Predefined Categories:
- Personal & Habits
- Creative & Side Projects
- Finance
- Self Development
- Professional Work
- Academic
- Health & Fitness

Key Design Principles:
- Shared classification fields across todoTasks and habitDefinitions
- All collections feed into dailySummaries
- Flexible habit completion types: boolean, duration, percentage, fraction, count, custom
- Procrastination tracked at:
  - minute-level (todos)
  - period-level (habits)

Pending:
- Charts and graphs system
- dailySummaries aggregation logic
- todo sessions[] support
- Workout schema
- API route design
- Frontend UI"

vertical monocular diplopia
(L, R) = perceived ghosting intensity per eye
Dual mode aligns with your “worst” state (both above and below visible)
Right eye drops to ~0 after ~35 min → left-eye–dominant perception during overload

Definitions (standardized)
Intensity (0–6): your original scale → perceived severity
Opacity (α): 0.0–1.0 (how visible the ghost is)
Position (%): vertical offset of ghost relative to source text
Top: ghost above text (e.g., +80%)
Bottom: ghost below text (e.g., −30%)
Mode:
Single: one ghost (top or bottom)
Dual: both top and bottom ghosts present
